Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching the signalized intersection in Katy, Texas, when the
vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was southbound and turning left across the lane of travel.
Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and said it began at the time of impact. The Passenger, seated in the front
right seat, confirmed being in the vehicle at the time of the collision and gave a statement consistent with Driver 1's
account. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses at the
corner gave matching accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door,
which is consistent with the reported angle of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named inusred on the policy involved.
Records reviewed during the investigation show extensive damage to the same area of the vehicle from a prior
incident that was never reported to police or the insurer, and that damage is now being presented as resulting from
this collision. Whether the reported shoulder injury was caused by this crash has not yet been determined.
